turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a smart choice! Matcha has a nice, steady energy boost without the coffee jitters. How's Sam doing? Did they have a good weekend too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam had a busy weekend visiting family, but they are doing well! I'm dressed up a bit more than usual today. I decided to wear a button-down shirt for my Zoom meetings today, even though I'm working from home.

turns.text: A button-down shirt always helps set a professional mindset, even for remote work! Do you have a lot of logistics client calls lined up today?

turns.text: Yeah, quite a few. I had a busy morning checking on some shipments, so I took a quick break for lunch. I had some vegetarian ramen today, which was perfect for this cold weather.

turns.text: Oh, ramen is absolute comfort food in December. Did you order it from that place near your apartment, or did you make it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually ordered it from a little spot down the street. They make an amazing vegetarian broth. It's so warm and filling.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious. Speaking of staying active in the cold, have you been getting over to the rock climbing gym lately, or are you taking a bit of a winter break?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've still been going! I went rock climbing on Friday evening with a friend. It's a great way to stay active when it's freezing outside.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's awesome. Friday climbs are the perfect transition into the weekend. How is the training going? Still running at all, or just focusing on climbing and guitar for now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm still doing some light jogs, but nothing intense like when I was training for the half marathon back in May. I'm mostly just enjoying the indoor climbing and playing music.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Makes sense, it's nice to have a more relaxed routine. I hope the rest of your Monday calls go smoothly and you have a cozy evening!

turns.speaker: user
